notes.title: Release Date Announced!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hey Deconstructors! 👋 [/b] [/h1]

[h2]We are extremely excited to announce something that you have awaited for a long time! 🔥[/h2]

[h1][b]Deconstruction Simulator releases on September 23, 2025! 🎉[/b][/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2487150/Deconstruction_Simulator

[previewyoutube=JrqZYxbvQDE;full][/previewyoutube]

After months of development, of communicating with you, ensuring every screw, every part is in the right place we are ready to show the full version of what we assembled for you! 🫵

[b]Everything we build will be for you to DESTROY! ⚒️[/b]

[h3][b]What you can expect in the upcoming full version?[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Over [b]40 of different contracts[/b] and maps, each of them made by hand, unique and beautiful!
[*] Complete destruction system where you can [b]destroy the whole house[/b] right into the fundamentals!
[*] [b]Improve your company in various ways[/b], from tools, to your own warehouse and vehicles in a satisfying progression loop!
[*] Freedom - You can be a goody two shoes worker, doing everything by the rules. But [b]nothing stops you from doing what you want[/b]. Steal from your clients, take what you want from their houses, if you can accept the consequences.
[*] And much more![/list]

Are you excited about the upcoming deconstruction!? We can't wait for you to explore the houses we made and uncover all the stories hidden in them! 

Join us on our Discord server to share all the excitement about the full release ! 💬

[h3][b]Don't miss the premiere - [u]September 23, 2025[/u] - hit the Wishlist & Follow button to make sure you are with us on the launch day! [/b][/h3]

[url=https://discord.gg/Dw8PG93s4z][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/1c96a12b016c0e622e7018d3024bcc232154d68f.png[/img][/url]

See you soon,
Deconstruction Simulator Team

notes.title: 🚧 Demo Update is Live! 🚧
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We’ve just released a new update for the Deconstruction Simulator demo - a small hotfix that addresses a few key issues reported by players.

Thanks so much for playing and sharing your feedback! 🙌

[u][b]Patch notes :[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] We have fixed an issue where a contract requiring the demolition of a house required the destruction of all objects in the house. Now, the game does not require you to find every single item to complete the task. We have also changed the task progress display from numbers to percentages.
[*] We have fixed a bug that caused some furniture to disappear from maps after leaving and returning to the contract location.
[*] We have fixed an issue that could cause players to get stuck in the tutorial due to insufficient debris to collect .
[*] Translations for all languages have been improved.
[/list]


See you soon
Deconstruction Simulator Team

notes.title: NEW DEMO UPDATE OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello there, Deconstructors! 👋[/h1]

We talked about a bunch of improvements in our previous devlogs, new contracts, new mechanics, new modes. All those exciting aspects, but no way to try them out...

[h3][b]Until today! 👇[/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2765650/Deconstruction_Simulator_Demo

We have released  the new version of the Demo [b]RIGHT NOW[/b], with a magnificent amount of improvements, many of which were mentioned in our devlogs.
Well no point in keeping your restless hammers waiting.

[h3][b]Here are the patch notes![/b] [/h3]
[list]
[b][*] Exciting new contracts, including a contract for a multi-story house. 🏚️
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/86ebc4335d0ed4ab229b08c49011314bc7e8a1b4.jpg[/img]
[*] Two game modes: Relaxed and Standard. The first allows players to play without penalties and with fewer time limits, while the second is the intended Deconstruction Simulator experience, with all its challenges. ⚙️

[*] Two furniture dismantling modes: Simplified and Standard. Simplified makes dismantling faster and less complicated. You can change it in the game settings. 🧰

[*] Access to a wrecking ball. One of the contracts allows you to see how the wrecking ball control system works. 🏗️

[*] Improved demolition. The hammer has become more precise, and the new sound effects make destruction extremely satisfying. 🔨

[*] Even more interesting house interiors. Every house in the game has gained a LOT of detail, which you can get a taste of in the demo. 🏡[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/1bb1e3abda6ff0dc27093fb95efd8118012f87cc.jpg[/img]

[*] Improved visuals. Deconstruction Simulator looks even better than before. 👀

[*] Improved optimization. The game runs noticeably better than Prologue, especially on less powerful devices. 🎞️

[*] Significant changes to gameplay balance. Both contracts and orders have been better adapted to player expectations, providing a more satisfying deconstruction. 🤑

[*] A whole host of fixes and improvements over the prologue. We've fixed hundreds of bugs and rebuilt several systems to ensure a smooth and enjoyable experience. 🛠️[/b]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/7005162a51b7b95a9b7192174caa84251dd6dc9e.jpg[/img]
For now, Deconstruction Simulator Demo is the latest and most refined version of the game available. If you want the best experience, this is the one to play.

To get yourself hyped, check out our  demo trailer! 👇
[previewyoutube=mRhSryDpysY;full][/previewyoutube]

All of your feedback helped us immensely in creating this update and in realizing our focus with Deconstruction Simulator! 💬

A bunch of your voices came from our official Discord, so how about joining us? 😎

[url=https://discord.gg/Dw8PG93s4z][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/1c96a12b016c0e622e7018d3024bcc232154d68f.png[/img][/url]


See you out in the field!
Deconstruction Simulator Team

notes.title: Beautiful Destruction in New Demo Version!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hello there, deconstruction specialists! 👋[/b][/h1]

With this devlog, we're gonna focus on something that we believe you'll appreciate. We don't want Deconstruction Simulator to be repetitive, where everytime you'll start, you will handle the same requests, the same places.
That is why we want today to focus on our variety of houses! 🏠

[h3]Deconstruction Simulator features dozens of different houses. Each one is unique and handcrafted by our team to bring you the most fun and personality. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/8c78c1aac79376e4045c3f8fb61f2482ad326484.jpg[/img]
Everyday the environment will be different around you, quiet suburbs, city center, or lush forests with a single hut are just some of them. 🏞️

[h3]You will venture from simple, small trailer houses to glamorous, modern mansions filled with plenty of elements![/h3] Each of them can be dismantled down to their foundations, even if you want to go against the client's request and receive a penalty. This brings a need to have a different strategy for each home, but you will always have [b]Relaxed mode [/b]to go from deconstruction to complete destruction! 💥

All of those you will slowly unlock through [b]tiers[/b]. Each tier unlocks a different type of house that will require a completely new strategy for their deconstruction challenges. 
While you will start from a simple trailer house, it will quickly go up in scale and complexity.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/f19c9127a0a5c2d47f3913f7bd2615798a7f5e75.jpg[/img]
As you are out there in the field, you can take a look around.  Every house tells a story, including its owner's, and with a keen eye you can find out plenty of clues about who you work for. 
It may be an average Silverhollow resident with a family, but some of them may be famous artists or shady politicians. 👨‍🎨 
Each house has a great amount of quirks, showing the personality of the owner.

You will see the ongoing stories of your clients, but also those that ended.
While playing the game you will find ruined houses that will require a different approach from what you will usually do! 🏚️
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/a5d5e9c4003ee9bc9f22d7402e03893cf137d5a3.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/7a7bbc5060ef42bf2444d69d6806f255699392a8.jpg[/img]


That's it for now, thank you for reading in, and look out for more devlogs, as each of them gets us closer and closer to the full release!
To be on par with all the news check out our official discord! 💬
[url=https://discord.gg/Dw8PG93s4z][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/1c96a12b016c0e622e7018d3024bcc232154d68f.png[/img][/url]

See you soon,
Deconstruction Simulator Team!

notes.title: 🎙️New Voice, New Vibes – Big Audio Update 1.0.3
notes.notes:
[h3][b]We’ve got big news – and it’s coming straight to your ears. 👂💥[/b][/h3]

[h3]Thanks to your feedback about the AI placeholder voice in the free Prologue, we decided not to wait any longer. [u]We're thrilled to introduce the real voice of Deconstruction Simulator:[/u]

[b]🎤 Nick Atlas[/b] – a pro voice actor whose work you might’ve heard in Dune: Spice Wars, Cultic, Spotify ads, and even Chevrolet.[/h3]

In the Prologue and Full Version of the game Nick brings life, personality, and a bit of attitude to both our protagonist and the grumpy boss from the beginning of the game. [b]The difference is night and day – trust us, you'll hear it immediately.[/b]

This isn’t just a patch. It’s a major upgrade to the feel of the whole experience for that what's is waiting for you in the Full Version of the Deconstruction Simulator 


[u][b]🔧 What else is new?[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]  Non-AI voice acting by Nick Atlas!
[*]  More optimization work, mainly related to lighting and physics
[*]  Significantly improved Low settings preset, allowing better optimization for lower-end hardware
[*]  Adjusted furniture destruction system when using a sledgehammer to be more satisfying
[*]  Adjusted Korean translation
[*]  Modified lighting inside houses
[*]  Changed the visuals of some of the pickable pictures
[*]  Fixed scanner-related issues
[/list]

[h3]We’re building the Deconstruction Simulator with you, and your feedback is the reason this upgrade the free Prologue now. 🙌
[/h3]

[u][b]So once you hear the new voice, let us know what you think — drop a comment “NICK IS KING!” into the comment.[/b][/u]


We read all your feedback. And we’re not done yet. 🏗️


See you soon,
Deconstruction Simulator Team

notes.title: Warehouse changes
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hello Deconstructors! 👋[/b][/h1]

We’re glad you’ve decided to join us and read the new devlog straight from our warehouse! Today we’d like to show you the changes and latest additions to this location. 🤩

First of all, we’ve given this place some more attention since the demo version. This resulted in a small redesign of the interior! 💪

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/b53e4d309d63d3fa9daf3644731074cb604fb3e3.png[/img]
[h3]We’ve implemented a new tab in the computer which is responsible for the warehouse. Along this tab come new possibilities- customization and upgrades. 🔨[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/e48e36b316e5ec99aca04fb914723f8a21656151.png[/img]
Upgrades will allow you to increase the size of your warehouse while customization will hopefully make your business feel more personal. Moving and reordering all the warehouse furniture, shelves, pallets. More space but not enough furniture? No problem. Buy everything you want in the shop and arrange your warehouse however you’d like.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/cbc2cbe6ed07b2c2ea99ec49c1e275b71e344e6f.png[/img]
[h3]In addition, we’ve added a whole separate room next to the warehouse- a garage which will also have its functionalities and upgrades! 🏘️[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/769757ffb3594554d76b68ce574411f7ffb7f382.png[/img]
These are the latest changes to this location. We’d love to hear if you like them or not. 🙂 We also encourage you to join our discord where you can meet other members of our community and stay informed about the latest events and changes in the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2487150/Deconstruction_Simulator/

[url=https://discord.gg/Dw8PG93s4z][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44337691/1c96a12b016c0e622e7018d3024bcc232154d68f.png[/img][/url] 

See you soon,
Deconstruction Simulator Team
